questions.question: In 42, which actor plays Jackie Robinson opposite Ford’s Branch Rickey?
questions.note: Boseman plays Robinson, and Ford plays Dodgers executive Branch Rickey.

questions.question: Cowboys & Aliens combines a Western setting with an invasion by what?
questions.note: Ford’s Colonel Dolarhyde joins Daniel Craig’s outlaw against extraterrestrial attackers.

questions.question: In 42, which baseball pioneer does Branch Rickey sign to the Brooklyn Dodgers?
questions.note: Ford plays the Dodgers executive who helps break Major League Baseball’s color barrier.

questions.question: Which younger actor stars between Harrison Ford and Gary Oldman in Paranoia?
questions.note: Hemsworth plays an employee forced to spy on Ford’s technology company for Oldman’s rival.

questions.question: In which comedy sequel does Ford make a cameo as veteran anchorman Mack Harken?
questions.note: Ford joins the movie’s crowded news-team battle as legendary anchor Mack Harken.

questions.question: Which action franchise casts Ford as CIA operative Max Drummer in its third film?
questions.note: Ford joins Sylvester Stallone’s ensemble in The Expendables 3.

questions.question: In The Age of Adaline, what unusual condition affects the title character?
questions.note: Ford’s William Jones knew Adaline decades before his son does.

questions.question: In The Secret Life of Pets 2, whose voice does Harrison Ford provide?
questions.note: Rooster is the farm dog who teaches Max to face his fears.

questions.question: In Ender’s Game, what are the alien enemies known as?
questions.note: Ford’s Colonel Graff trains Ender Wiggin for humanity’s war against the Formics.

questions.question: Which actor plays the young protagonist opposite Ford in Ender’s Game?
questions.note: Butterfield plays Ender Wiggin, whom Graff recruits for Battle School.
